meta.title: How It Works
meta.description: Local speed when your devices are near, a link when they’re not. See how BIShare moves files nearby and shares them anywhere — end-to-end encrypted, no account required.

hero.title: Local-first, cloud when you need it
hero.sub: Nearby, files move at local speed and never touch a server. Far apart, they take a link — a URL, a QR code, a six-character code. No account required.

flow.title: Four steps, zero ceremony
flow.sub: One encrypted pipeline from your hand to theirs — the beam is the whole journey.

steps.title: Choose your files
steps.desc: Photos, videos, folders, entire projects — pick anything in the app, or drop it straight into your browser at bishare.app.

steps.title: Pick a destination
steps.desc: A device that appears nearby, a link for someone far away, or a room for the whole group. BIShare finds nearby devices automatically.

steps.title: It travels encrypted
steps.desc: Every transfer is sealed with AES-256 before it leaves your device. Nearby transfers go direct and never touch a server.

steps.title: It arrives. That’s it.
steps.desc: Files land intact and verified. Anything shared through a link deletes itself after 24 hours.

routes.title: Four ways to get there
routes.sub: Pick whichever fits the moment — they all end with the file where it belongs.

faq.title: Details, answered
faq.sub: The short version of everything people ask us.

items.a: No. Anyone can send and receive transfers without signing up — there’s nothing to create, no email, and no profile to manage. Install and start sending.

items.q: Does the other person need the app?
items.a: Not necessarily. Anyone can download a shared file in their browser using the link or code, and browser access lets any computer on your network exchange files with your device. The app makes everything faster — but it’s never required on both ends.
Between devices on the same network: no limit — send a 40 GB folder if you like. Shares that travel through a link are free up to 10 GB per file and are deleted after 24 hours.

Yes. Transfers are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using X25519 key exchange. Nearby transfers travel device-to-device and never touch a server; remote shares are held on secure infrastructure and deleted automatically.
Shared files are permanently deleted — links and codes simply stop working. One-time links go further and delete themselves after the very first download.

items.q: What if a transfer gets interrupted?
items.a: Browser uploads are resumable: if the connection drops or a tab closes, the upload continues from where it stopped instead of starting over.
iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux — plus any modern web browser for receiving and one-off sends. The app is available in 13 languages.

items.q: Can I share with a whole group?
items.a: Yes — create a room. Share its four-character code and up to 20 people can join, each able to upload and download files. Rooms work locally without internet, or anywhere through a link.

items.q: Can I control who sends to me?
items.a: Fully. Set a PIN that senders must enter, choose who can discover your device — everyone, favorites only, or nobody — and enable auto-accept only for devices you trust.

cta.title: Try it right now
cta.sub: Send your first file from the browser in under a minute — or get the app for the full experience.
